description: This file defines the SoapHelperWebServices class, which provides web service methods for managing and interacting with SugarCRM/SuiteCRM data, including user validation, retrieving module fields, handling relationships, and CRUD operations for various modules.

classes.name: SoapHelperWebServices
classes.description: Provides web service methods for interacting with SugarCRM/SuiteCRM data, including user validation, field retrieval, relationship management, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of module fields and link fields based on the provided value object and fields array.

methods.name: setFaultObject
methods.description: Sets an error object into the global service object, printing debug info if debug level is set.

methods.name: validate_user
methods.description: Validates user credentials and establishes a session if successful.

methods.name: validate_authenticated
methods.description: Validates that a session ID corresponds to a valid, active user session.

methods.name: is_valid_ip_address
methods.description: Checks if the client's IP address matches the session's IP address constraints.

methods.name: checkSessionAndModuleAccess
methods.description: Verifies session validity and checks if the current user has access to a specified module.

methods.name: checkACLAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has ACL access to a bean for a specified view type.

methods.name: checkQuery
methods.description: Validates that a SQL query string is safe and well-formed.

methods.name: get_name_value
methods.description: Creates a name-value pair array.

methods.name: get_user_module_list
methods.description: Returns the list of modules accessible by the user.

methods.name: check_modules_access
methods.description: Checks if a user has proper access to a module for a specific action.

methods.name: get_name_value_list
methods.description: Generates a list of name-value pairs from the given object.

methods.name: filter_fields
methods.description: Filters out invalid or restricted fields based on the object and permission restrictions.

methods.name: get_name_value_list_for_fields
methods.description: Creates a list of name-value pairs for specified fields of an object.

methods.name: array_get_name_value_list
methods.description: Converts an associative array into a list of name-value pair arrays.

methods.name: array_get_name_value_lists
methods.description: Converts an array of arrays into a list of name-value pair arrays.

methods.name: name_value_lists_get_array
methods.description: Transforms a list of name-value pairs into an associative array.

methods.name: array_get_return_value
methods.description: Constructs a return array with id, module name, and name-value list.

methods.name: get_return_value_for_fields
methods.description: Builds a standardized return structure for a record's fields.

methods.name: get_return_value
methods.description: Returns a structured array representing a record with id, module, and name-value list.

methods.name: get_return_module_fields
methods.description: Returns module name, fields, and link fields info for a given object.

methods.name: login_success
methods.description: Sets user language and notifications based on login, and initializes session language context.

methods.name: checkSaveOnNotify
methods.description: Checks if a user preference for notification on save is set.

methods.name: add_create_account
methods.description: Creates or associates an account with a contact based on account_name or account_id.

methods.name: check_for_duplicate_contacts
methods.description: Checks whether a contact with similar email and name exists to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: decrypt_string
methods.description: Decrypts a string using TripleDES (OpenSSL) if available, else returns input.

methods.name: isLogLevelDebug
methods.description: Checks if the logging level is set to debug for detailed logging.
